description: This file defines the 'Link' class in the Drupal JSON:API module, representing an RFC8288-based link with methods for comparison, merging, and retrieving link properties.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: Represents an RFC8288-based link with properties for URI, relation type, and attributes, including methods for comparison and merging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Link object with cacheability, URL, relation type, and optional target attributes.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URL object representing the link's URI.

methods.name: getHref
methods.description: Returns the link's URI as a string.

methods.name: getLinkRelationType
methods.description: Returns the relation type of the link.

methods.name: getTargetAttributes
methods.description: Returns the target attributes of the link.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two Link objects for equality based on href, rel, and target attributes.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges two equivalent Link objects into one with combined cacheability.
